name: Screen Print Wipe
description: A squeegee sweeps back and forth across the frame four times, pushing a bead of ink ahead of its blade and printing the second clip one halftone ink at a time, yellow, magenta, cyan then black, slightly out of register and streaky, until the layers settle into register and the dots melt into the full picture. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: dots
params.description: Number of halftone dots across the frame height: more makes a finer screen, which can shimmer at small sizes

params.name: misregistration
params.description: How far the ink layers are printed out of register, in frame heights

params.name: grit
params.description: Amount of ink texture: squeegee streaks and ink-starved specks
